parso mummy ka birthday hai, cake order karna hai. kya suggest karoge?
1:19 AM

Parso Sat 24 Oct ko mummy ka birthday hai, to cake kal tak order kar dena sahi rahega, khaaskar agar custom chahiye. Ye options achhe rahenge:

Chocolate truffle: rich aur sabko pasand aane wala.
Butterscotch ya black forest: classic, kabhi galat nahi jaata.
Fresh fruit ya pineapple: halka aur kam meetha.
Photo cake: mummy ki pasandida photo aur ek chhota sa message ke saath.

Mummy ko kaunsa flavour sabse zyada pasand hai, aur cake eggless chahiye?
